author: facesix
quote: I turned it on, played for two hours, then turned it off. 30 frames per second on the PS5 Pro in 2026 is a joke shooting feels like you’re in mud, and driving feels like you’re on ice. Rockstar turned GTA into Red Dead Redemption 2: everything weighs a ton, everything is animated, and you just watch as the game plays out its little show instead of being part of it. There’s less freedom than in GTA V; the map is just a backdrop for the script, not a sandbox there’s nowhere to do something silly and have fun with it. The controls are clunky, the menu looks like a spreadsheet.
